section: Cyber security concerns - types of cyber crime, malware, ransomware, phishing, social engineering

accepted.s: In the ITU Global Cybersecurity Index 2024, India was placed in which category, with what score?
o: Tier-1 (Role Modelling), with a score of 98.49
Tier-1 (Role Modelling), with a score of 88.49
accepted.x: India was placed in Tier-1, described as ‘Role Modelling’, and secured a score of 98.49 in the ITU Global Cybersecurity Index 2024.
accepted.tq: Separate the category from the score and check both parts of the option.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding emerging cyber security threats:
1. AI-powered malware can adapt in order to evade antivirus systems.
2. Malicious autonomous agents can undermine the principle of Zero Trust.
3. AI-enabled phishing targeting Instagram accounts was highlighted in June 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. AI-powered malware is capable of adapting to evade antivirus protection, malicious autonomous agents threaten Zero Trust, and AI-enabled phishing of Instagram accounts was noted in June 2026.
accepted.tq: Test each statement independently before selecting the inclusive combination.

accepted.s: The concern regarding AI-powered malware adapting to evade antivirus protection and malicious autonomous agents undermining Zero Trust was highlighted in which month and year?
accepted.x: This concern was highlighted in August 2026. The related report also referred to the threat posed by malicious autonomous agents to Zero Trust systems.
accepted.tq: Use the date-specific clue to distinguish current cyber security developments.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the cyber security initiative involving Andhra Pradesh Police and IIT Tirupati?
o: A Cyber Crime Investigation and Training Academy established through a Memorandum of Understanding, focusing on digital forensics and blockchain tracing
A Cyber Crime Investigation Academy established by the ITU for monitoring global cyber rankings
A National Malware Research Centre established under the Andhra Pradesh Cyber Security Policy 2017
A Blockchain Training Academy established by the Supreme Court for processing zero FIRs
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Police and IIT Tirupati entered into a Memorandum of Understanding in February 2026 for a Cyber Crime Investigation and Training Academy, with emphasis on digital forensics and blockchain tracing.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct institution-purpose combination and reject swapped authorities.

accepted.s: In response to digital-arrest scams, which of the following measures was ordered by the Supreme Court?
o: Creation of a separate cyber court in every district and permanent blocking of digital wallets
A ban on all digital payments and mandatory reporting only by private companies
Compulsory encryption of all social-media accounts and suspension of online banking
Standard Operating Procedures, zero FIRs and time-bound refunds
accepted.x: The Supreme Court ordered Standard Operating Procedures, registration of zero FIRs and time-bound refunds in cases involving digital-arrest scams.
accepted.tq: Match the judicial direction with the specific remedies rather than broader cybercrime measures.

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh Cyber Security Policy referred to in the context of cybercrime prevention was introduced in:
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Cyber Security Policy was introduced in 2017.
accepted.tq: Check the year against the nearby current initiatives and avoid confusing policy and MoU dates.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the significance of cyber security:
1. Cyber security is important for national security.
2. Cyber threats can affect the economy and public services.
3. Cyber incidents can weaken trust in e-governance.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Cyber threats have implications for national security, the economy, public services and public trust in e-governance.
accepted.tq: Recognise the common significance theme and test whether each listed consequence belongs to it.
